name: Samsung 45W USB-C Power Adapter (without cable)
shortDescription: Samsung's 45W USB-C travel adapter with Super Fast Charging 2.0. Cable not included.
description:
A single-port USB-C wall charger with up to 45W output. It supports Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0 on models such as the Galaxy S22 Ultra, S23 Ultra and S24 Ultra, and Super Fast Charging on most recent Galaxy phones and tablets.

It also follows USB Power Delivery 3.0 (PDO/PPS), so it charges other USB-C devices. Only the adapter is in the box.
highlights: Super Fast Charging 2.0 for supported Galaxy models

items.label: Features
items.value: Super Fast Charging 2.0 max. 45W, PD 3.0 PDO/PPS max. 45W
